method: Curated non-core watchlist ideas ranked by conviction; levels anchored to the Aug 28 close and real 52-wk range (sell>buy>stop).

ideas.why: SK Hynix is the HBM leader; NVDA's 'rising memory costs' guide-down is a direct read-through that HBM pricing is surging - the cleanest memory beneficiary alongside MU.
bull: HBM shortage + AI demand drive a multi-quarter pricing up-cycle
NVDA's margin warning = SK Hynix's revenue tailwind
bear: Memory is deeply cyclical - up-cycles end fast
ADR liquidity/FX and Korea-specific risks
ideas.inv: Cyclical: ride the HBM up-cycle but honour the stop.
ideas.thesis: A core memory-cycle idea; the NVDA read-through is the catalyst - buy pullbacks.

ideas.why: Netflix is the profitable streaming leader with ad-tier + password-sharing monetisation driving FCF; +2.4% to 81.72, resilient in a choppy week.
bull: Ad tier + paid sharing expand revenue and FCF
Content moat + global scale; consistent profitability
bear: Reverse-DCF implies ~13% FCF CAGR - a full multiple
Streaming competition and content-cost inflation
ideas.inv: Core compounder: own on weakness, respect valuation.
ideas.thesis: A quality streaming compounder; accumulate on dips.

ideas.why: Alibaba is the Chinese e-commerce + cloud/AI leader; a rare top-brass cluster buy (Chairman Tsai + CEO Wu, >$15.3M) landed this week, +2.2% to 118.9.
bull: Chairman + CEO cluster buy - strong insider signal
Cloud/AI reacceleration + cheap valuation
bear: China regulatory + geopolitical/ADR risk
Consumer-recovery in China still uneven
ideas.inv: Value + smart-money: own for the re-rating, mind China risk.
ideas.thesis: A value + insider-signal China idea; size for the geopolitical risk.

ideas.why: Vertiv makes data-center power + thermal (liquid cooling) gear - a direct AI-capex play; -4.5% to 257.08 in the rate-sensitive power sell-off.
bull: Liquid-cooling + power gear ride the AI-datacenter build
Strong backlog and order momentum
bear: Rate-sensitive 'AI-power' multiple got hit
Cyclical if data-center capex slows
ideas.inv: AI-capex play: buy weakness, expect rate volatility.
ideas.thesis: A high-quality AI-infrastructure idea; accumulate on the rate-driven dip.

ideas.why: CrowdStrike is the endpoint/XDR leader; -4.2% to 218.4 as security de-rated on rates, but it sits just ~5% below its 229 high with elite retention.
bull: Platform consolidation + best-in-class retention
Near 52-wk high despite the sector de-rate
bear: Among the richest multiples in security
Rate-sensitive; sold off this week
ideas.inv: Own for platform strength; size for volatility.
ideas.thesis: A quality security leader; buy the rate dip, not the high.

ideas.why: Okta is the independent identity-security leader; -3.9% to 166.23 as high-multiple security de-rated on rates, but it sits just ~5% below its 174 high with improving FCF.
bull: Identity is a sticky, expanding security budget line
Near 52-wk high with improving free cash flow
bear: Rich multiple; sold off with software on rates
Competition from Microsoft Entra in identity
ideas.inv: Own for durable identity spend; size moderate.
ideas.thesis: A quality identity-security idea; buy the rate-driven dip, not the high.

ideas.why: Lululemon is a premium athleisure brand that has de-rated hard to 120.81 (~47% below its high); +5.0% Friday - a value/turnaround on brand durability.
bull: Strong brand + international growth runway
Deep discount-to-high; reverse-DCF implies negative required growth (cheap)
bear: US growth has slowed; brand-fatigue risk
Discretionary spend softening (see DKS -30% guide cut)
ideas.inv: Value: buy weakness only with growth-stabilisation signs.
ideas.thesis: A value consumer turnaround; accumulate on brand-recovery evidence.

ideas.why: SoFi is a fast-growing digital bank now GAAP-profitable; -5.8% to 18.06 on the rate spike hitting fintech risk appetite, ~45% below its high.
bull: Member growth + cross-sell + newly consistent profits
Bank charter lowers funding costs
bear: High-beta fintech - sold off hard on rates
Credit-cycle risk as the loan book scales
Not yet consistently profitable - conviction capped.
ideas.inv: High-beta: size small, watch credit trends.
ideas.thesis: A high-growth fintech; buy weakness, keep small.

ideas.why: Bloom Energy makes fuel-cell power for data centers; Pelosi disclosed leveraged call buying and it bounced off its 200-DMA to 210.77 - a smart-money-flagged AI-power name.
bull: Pelosi call-option buying is a notable smart-money signal
Fuel cells offer fast, grid-independent data-center power
bear: Not consistently profitable - story valuation
-3.2% Friday; high-beta and rate-sensitive
ideas.inv: Story stock: the Pelosi buy is the hook, but cap conviction.
ideas.thesis: A smart-money-flagged AI-power idea; size small given the story valuation.

ideas.why: Nebius is a fast-growing AI-cloud (GPU) provider; -4.3% to 209.18 in the high-beta AI sell-off - big TAM, not yet consistently profitable.
bull: Neocloud GPU demand is exploding
High revenue growth + scarce AI capacity
bear: Not consistently profitable - capital-intensive
High-beta; -4.3% on the rate scare
ideas.thesis: A speculative neocloud idea; size small.

ideas.why: IREN is pivoting mining sites into AI/HPC data-center capacity; -12.5% Friday to 35.45 shows how violently these story names trade on the rate scare.
bull: Low-cost power + AI-datacenter conversion optionality
Leverage to any AI-capacity land-grab
bear: Not consistently profitable - pure risk asset
-12.5% in one day; extreme volatility, ~54% below high
ideas.inv: Story stock: size tiny, expect large swings.
ideas.thesis: A speculative AI-power/miner option; only tiny, venture-style sizing - momentum is broken.

ideas.why: Lyft is the #2 US rideshare turning consistently FCF-positive; +2.0% to 17.7, a rare green name, on self-help margin gains and buybacks.
bull: FCF inflection + buybacks shrink the float
Duopoly pricing discipline with Uber
bear: #2 to Uber with less scale
Autonomous-vehicle disruption is a long-term risk
ideas.inv: Turnaround: size moderate, watch the AV threat.
ideas.thesis: A self-help consumer turnaround; cheap optionality if margins keep rising.
